front.title: Update to the Internet X.509 Public Key Infrastructure Time-Stamp Protocol (TSP)

abstract.t: This document updates RFC 3161. It adds a requirement to ensure that the id-ct-TSTInfo content type is used to align with the best practices for signed attributes with CMS signed-data. In addition, cross-protocol attacks are prevented by requiring that the Time Stamp Authority (TSA) dedicate the signature key pair to the time-stamping service.
